{
  "problem_id": "TA-001",
  "lane_id": "openai-raw",
  "provider": "openai",
  "model_or_runtime": "Frontier OpenAI reasoning-model ensemble with long-context models, code execution, symbolic and numerical mathematics tools, theorem-prover interfaces, retrieval, and isolated replication agents",
  "execution_posture": "non_governed",
  "estimated_input_tokens": 450000000,
  "estimated_output_tokens": 120000000,
  "estimated_reasoning_tokens": 900000000,
  "estimated_candidate_branches": 2400,
  "estimated_failed_branches": 2200,
  "estimated_retries": 7000,
  "estimated_search_cost": 180000,
  "estimated_governance_overhead": 0,
  "estimated_verification_cost": 1400000,
  "estimated_total_cost_low": 2200000,
  "estimated_total_cost_central": 7800000,
  "estimated_total_cost_high": 35000000,
  "estimated_elapsed_hours_low": 2500,
  "estimated_elapsed_hours_central": 7500,
  "estimated_elapsed_hours_high": 22000,
  "estimated_success_probability": 0.04,
  "estimated_reproduction_probability": 0.42,
  "estimated_independent_result_probability": 0.025,
  "confidence": 0.23,
  "assumptions": [
    "These are prospective engineering estimates, not claims of observed feasibility and not derived from any published aggregate cost estimate.",
    "The target requires a genuinely publishable high-dimensional sphere-packing upper-bound result reaching the stated Cohn–Elkies threshold, rather than an exposition, numerical observation, or minor parameter improvement.",
    "Reproduction probability means reconstructing a correct proof when the relevant published argument is available for ingestion; independent-result probability means rediscovering or deriving a qualifying result without using that proof as a blueprint.",
    "The system may ingest the broader literature on linear-programming bounds, harmonic analysis, special functions, asymptotic analysis, optimization, and formal proof, while preserving a separate evaluation track for independent rediscovery.",
    "Token estimates are central workload quantities across researcher, critic, verifier, formalizer, retrieval, and replication agents; reasoning tokens include internal deliberative computation where metered or approximated.",
    "Costs include model inference, retrieval, storage, orchestration, numerical and symbolic computation, theorem-prover workloads, repeated proof reconstruction, and manuscript production.",
    "The non-governed posture has no priced identity hashing, budget enforcement, branch-receipt, evidence-preservation, or policy-check layer; publication-grade verification remains included separately.",
    "Substantial parallelism is assumed, so elapsed hours are wall-clock program duration rather than the sum of agent-hours.",
    "The central plan reserves roughly ten percent of total expenditure for literature ingestion and exploratory mapping, fifty-five percent for mathematical search and failed branches, eighteen percent for verification and replication, ten percent for formalization, and seven percent for manuscript and artifact preparation.",
    "Formalization may cover the central analytic lemmas and machine-checkable finite or computational claims rather than every line of the final paper."
  ],
  "uncertainty_drivers": [
    "Ambiguity in the exact interpretation of reaching the Cohn–Elkies threshold and whether a new asymptotic idea is required.",
    "Unknown capability of available reasoning models on long, delicate chains of harmonic and asymptotic analysis.",
    "The possibility that the target needs a conceptual breakthrough not discoverable through scalable branch search.",
    "Difficulty detecting subtle positivity, normalization, limiting, interchange-of-integral, and dimension-uniformity errors.",
    "Potentially prohibitive numerical conditioning or interval-arithmetic requirements.",
    "Large variance in useful literature retrieval versus unproductive rediscovery of known dead ends.",
    "Model pricing, context limits, hidden-reasoning accounting, and tool reliability at execution time.",
    "The amount of proof-assistant library development needed for special-function and asymptotic arguments.",
    "Whether independent replication agents converge on genuinely distinct proofs or share correlated failure modes.",
    "Peer-review demands for stronger constants, broader dimensional ranges, or cleaner hypotheses."
  ],
  "minimum_evidence": [
    "A precise theorem that unambiguously states the new density bound, dimension regime, constants, asymptotic quantifiers, and relationship to the target threshold.",
    "A complete proof with every positivity, transform, convergence, and asymptotic step justified uniformly in the required dimension range.",
    "A literature comparison establishing novelty and ruling out equivalent prior formulations.",
    "Independent reconstruction of the proof by at least two isolated verifier agents using separate derivations.",
    "Machine-checked or interval-certified validation of every computation on which the theorem depends.",
    "Adversarial critic passes targeting normalization conventions, hidden regularity assumptions, endpoint behavior, and invalid limit exchanges.",
    "Formalization of the theorem's core analytic lemmas or an explicit audit trail explaining any components not practically formalized.",
    "A clean-room replication from the theorem statement and cited background only, with discrepancies reconciled.",
    "Reproducible source code, exact environments, data and parameter hashes, computational logs, and deterministic artifact-generation instructions.",
    "A publication-ready manuscript with theorem dependencies, computational appendices, and a documented response to an independent simulated peer review."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "No available model may reliably originate the required new analytic construction.",
    "Candidate auxiliary functions may satisfy numerical tests while failing exact positivity or admissibility conditions.",
    "The desired threshold may require machinery absent from current formal libraries and too expensive to build within budget.",
    "Correlated hallucinations across agents can create false consensus about a central lemma.",
    "Numerical evidence may be impossible to upgrade to a dimension-uniform rigorous argument.",
    "The target may be underspecified enough that apparent success does not meet expert publication standards.",
    "A later literature search may reveal that the purportedly new bound is already known or is an immediate reformulation.",
    "Independent verification may expose an irreparable gap only after most search expenditure has been consumed."
  ]
}
